A [[White Jingle Moa]] is a [[charmable animal]] found within [[Gwen's garden]] after completion of the [[Snowball Dominance]]. It deals [[piercing damage]].

==Locations==
* [[Core]]
** [[The Battle Isles]]
*** {{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
* [[Eye of the North]]
** [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
*** {{NPC location|Ice Cliff Chasms}} (in [[Gwen's garden]], after completing [[Snowball Dominance]])
*** {{NPC location|Secret Lair of the Snowmen}} (these cannot be charmed)

==Notes==
* Unlike most charmable animals, the White Jingle Moa cannot be attacked and doesn't [[attack]] when attempting to [[Charm Animal|charm]] it.
* The White Jingle Moas appear in the Zaishen Menagerie Grounds without chicks.
* A single White Jingle Moa can be captured in Gwen's garden at any time, once the quest requirements have been met. You must [[zone|rezone]] if you wish more than one member of your party to obtain one.
* [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 2{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} or 20,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Prestige, Exotic).''
{{anomaly| The Jingle pets will appear if at least one player in the party has completed the relevant quests.}}
<!-- Joe Kimmes has confirmed that the following is a bug. Please discuss before changing the status; the talk page has a relevant section, "Exotic is bug." -->
{{bug| Unlike the [[Jingle Bear]], the White Jingle Moa counts as an ''exotic'' pet.}} 

== Trivia ==

* The White Jingle Moa was introduced in [[Wintersday 2009]]. At that time, the [[Wintersday 2009#Quests|quests required to unlock]] it were given by [[Lieutenant Thackeray]].
